page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n4d server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture and is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance for general-purpose workloads such as web serving, application hosting, and moderate database tasks. Because it lacks local NVMe SSDs and hardware accelerators, it is less suitable for high-performance storage-heavy operations or GPU-accelerated machine learning tasks.
